description: The complete China income tax computation for 2026, as on the return. Covers: Residents and non-residents: 183 days, the six-year rule, China-source wages, the 90-day exemption; Comprehensive income: wages, labour services (80%), author's remuneration (56%), royalties (80%), 3–45% annually; ¥60,000 standard deduction, all special additional deductions (2023 amounts), personal pension, health insurance, donations; Annual bonus taxed separately or combined, and foreigners' tax-free allowances or special deductions, the cheaper noted; Social insurance and housing fund for Shanghai, Beijing, Shenzhen and Guangzhou with floors and ceilings; other cities by amount; and more. Returns the tax, the balance still to pay or to be refunded after taxes already paid, every option the law offers compared, and each step with its legal reference. All amounts in CNY; everything is optional, give only what applies. What is not modelled is listed in the result.
